nearMatches.title: Deployed Customer Engineer
nearMatches.text:
Couchbase, the operational data platform for AI, empowers businesses to succeed by bringing data to life in new ways. Major market-leading companies rely on Couchbase for mission critical operational, analytical, mobile and AI workloads. Built to replace legacy infrastructure and fragmented data services, Couchbase empowers enterprises with a unified platform architected for performance, flexibility and global scale.

With Couchbase, organizations bring their data to life, launching game‑changing customer experiences, exploring the limitless potential of AI, and seamlessly extending applications from the cloud to the edge and beyond. Couchbase’s AI‑ready technology and enterprise partnership model eliminate complexity and reduce total cost of ownership, enabling teams to stay agile, innovative and secure.

Couchbase believes data should never slow you down, but act as the foundation for your next breakthrough. Discover why Couchbase is trusted to help the world’s biggest players scale, move fast and stay resilient, no matter what’s next on their roadmap. Visit couchbase.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Want to be part of our story? Apply today! 

Location: Remote Singapore (Global travel as required)

Reports to: Tech Health Lead

As a Deployed Customer Engineer (DCE), you are the technical bridge between Couchbase’s engineering excellence and our customers’ most ambitious business goals. You are an embedded technical partner who writes production-grade code, builds high-performance database architectures, and ensures our platform powers the heart of mission-critical, AI-driven applications. You will deliver strategic solutioning and work within customer engineering teams to deliver business outcomes through technical implementations.

Unlike traditional engineers or solutions architects, the DCE operates at the intersection of:

  • Software Engineering
  • Systems Architecture
  • Customer Success
  • Product Feedback

The DCE is responsible for accelerating customer outcomes by:

  • Building real-world implementations and pilot solutions
  • Solving complex technical challenges
  • Translating customer needs into scalable solutions
  • Acting as a bridge between customers and internal product/engineering teams

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Implementation & Development

  • Hands-on Coding: Write clean, scalable code to build integrations, APIs, and data models that connect Couchbase with customer ecosystems.
  • Product Configuration: Expertly configure Couchbase Server, Capella (DBaaS), and Mobile products to optimize for latency, throughput, and reliability.
  • Architecture Design: Design and implement advanced data architectures, including Vector Search and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns for modern AI applications.

2. Customer Integration & Success

  • Embedded Partnership: Integrate directly with customer development teams, participating in sprints and code reviews to ensure best practices are understood, implemented, and governed.
  • Problem Solving: Act as the "boots on the ground" to troubleshoot complex distributed systems issues, performance bottlenecks, and deployment hurdles.
  • Value Realization: Translate business requirements into technical milestones, ensuring the customer achieves a rapid Time-to-Value.

3. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Product Feedback Loop: Act as a conduit between the field and our core Product/Engineering teams, advocating for features and fixes based on real-world usage.
  • Sales Alignment: Partner with Solution Engineers to identify expansion opportunities by demonstrating the "art of the possible" within existing accounts.

Skills & Abilities

  • Polyglot Developer: Strong proficiency in at least two major languages (e.g., Java, Python, Go, Node.js, or C#).
  • Database Native: Deep understanding of NoSQL concepts, distributed systems, and SQL-based query languages (N1QL).
  • Consultative Mindset: Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to both developers and executive stakeholders.
  • Operational Agility: Comfortable navigating Cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP),  container orchestration (Kubernetes/OpenShift), and networking (VPCs, DNS, load balancing, security).

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Technical Consulting.
  • Domain Expertise: Proven track record of deploying large-scale distributed databases or data intensive applications.
  • Couchbase Values: A drive to "Attack Hard Problems" and the empathy to "Be A Great Human" while working inside a customer’s environment.

Success Metrics (12–18 Months)

  • Deployment Velocity: Reduction in the average time from initial kickoff to production "Go-Live."
  • Technical Health: High performance-to-cost ratios for customer clusters and 0% churn due to technical blockers. Author digital runbooks, Gemini Gems, or other technical best practices documentation including approaches and configuration details.
  • Community Impact: Contribution of reusable code samples, connectors, utilities, or documentation to the Couchbase ecosystem.
  • Expansion: Identification and technical validation of at least 2 new use cases within assigned strategic accounts.

 

At Couchbase, we believe innovation thrives when diverse perspectives are at the table. We actively encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds—including women, people of color, LGTBQIA+ professionals, veterans, and individuals with disabilities. If you see a role that excites you, but don’t meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

Studies show underrepresented talent is less likely to apply unless they meet all the criteria. We encourage you to apply if you’re excited about the role and can bring strong contributions to our team.

If you require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let your recruiter know—we’re happy to support you.

We value diverse educational and career backgrounds. If your experience aligns with the role’s goals—even if it doesn’t follow a traditional path—we’d love to hear from you.

 Why Couchbase?
Modern customer experiences need a flexible cloud database platform that can power applications spanning from cloud to edge and everything in between. Couchbase’s mission is to simplify how developers and architects develop, deploy and consume modern applications wherever they are. We have reimagined the database with our fast, flexible and affordable cloud database platform Capella, allowing organizations to quickly build applications that deliver premium experiences to their customers– all with best-in-class price performance. More than 30% of the Fortune 100 trust Couchbase to power their modern applications and build innovative new ones. See our recent awards to learn why Couchbase is a great place to work.We are honored to be a part of the Best Places to Work Award for the Bay Area and the UK. Couchbase offers a total rewards approach to benefits  that recognizes the value you create here, so that you in turn may best serve yourself and your family. Some benefits include:
  • Generous Time Off Program - Flexibility to care for you and your family
  • Wellness Benefits - A variety of world class medical plans to choose from, along with dental, vision, life insurance, and employee assistance programs*
  • Financial Planning - Retirement program* and Business Travel Insurance
  • Career Growth - Be valued, Create value approach
  • Fun Perks - An ergonomic and comfortable in-office / WFH setup. Food & Snacks for in-office employees.
  • And much more!
*Note: some programs are not applicable to all countries. Please discuss with a Couchbase recruiter to learn more.

Couchbase Capella
Couchbase Blog
Investors

Join an impact initiative group and experience the amazing feeling of Couchbase can-do culture.

As a Deployed Customer Engineer (DCE), you are the technical bridge between Couchbase’s engineering excellence and our customers’ most ambitious business goals. You are an embedded technical partner who writes production-grade code, builds high-performance database architectures, and ensures our platform powers the heart of mission-critical, AI-driven applications. You will deliver strategic solutioning and work within customer engineering teams to deliver business outcomes through technical implementations.

Unlike traditional engineers or solutions architects, the DCE operates at the intersection of:

  • Software Engineering
  • Systems Architecture
  • Customer Success
  • Product Feedback

The DCE is responsible for accelerating customer outcomes by:

  • Building real-world implementations and pilot solutions
  • Solving complex technical challenges
  • Translating customer needs into scalable solutions
  • Acting as a bridge between customers and internal product/engineering teams

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Implementation & Development

  • Hands-on Coding: Write clean, scalable code to build integrations, APIs, and data models that connect Couchbase with customer ecosystems.
  • Product Configuration: Expertly configure Couchbase Server, Capella (DBaaS), and Mobile products to optimize for latency, throughput, and reliability.
  • Architecture Design: Design and implement advanced data architectures, including Vector Search and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns for modern AI applications.

2. Customer Integration & Success

  • Embedded Partnership: Integrate directly with customer development teams, participating in sprints and code reviews to ensure best practices are understood, implemented, and governed.
  • Problem Solving: Act as the "boots on the ground" to troubleshoot complex distributed systems issues, performance bottlenecks, and deployment hurdles.
  • Value Realization: Translate business requirements into technical milestones, ensuring the customer achieves a rapid Time-to-Value.

3. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Product Feedback Loop: Act as a conduit between the field and our core Product/Engineering teams, advocating for features and fixes based on real-world usage.
  • Sales Alignment: Partner with Solution Engineers to identify expansion opportunities by demonstrating the "art of the possible" within existing accounts.

Skills & Abilities

  • Polyglot Developer: Strong proficiency in at least two major languages (e.g., Java, Python, Go, Node.js, or C#).
  • Database Native: Deep understanding of NoSQL concepts, distributed systems, and SQL-based query languages (N1QL).
  • Consultative Mindset: Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to both developers and executive stakeholders.
  • Operational Agility: Comfortable navigating Cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP),  container orchestration (Kubernetes/OpenShift), and networking (VPCs, DNS, load balancing, security).

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Technical Consulting.
  • Domain Expertise: Proven track record of deploying large-scale distributed databases or data intensive applications.
  • Couchbase Values: A drive to "Attack Hard Problems" and the empathy to "Be A Great Human" while working inside a customer’s environment.

Success Metrics (12–18 Months)

  • Deployment Velocity: Reduction in the average time from initial kickoff to production "Go-Live."
  • Technical Health: High performance-to-cost ratios for customer clusters and 0% churn due to technical blockers. Author digital runbooks, Gemini Gems, or other technical best practices documentation including approaches and configuration details.
  • Community Impact: Contribution of reusable code samples, connectors, utilities, or documentation to the Couchbase ecosystem.

closest.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
closest.text: Business Area: Corp. Strategy Seniority Level: Director Job Description: At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises. About the Team Cloudera’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) function sits within the Applied AI organization and is a specialized AI/ML engineering team focused on accelerating AI adoption within our most strategic enterprise customers. We embed directly with customers to rapidly pilot AI use cases, solve real-world business challenges, and help operationalize advanced AI capabilities within enterprise environments. Cloudera FDEs operate at the intersection of customer engineering, AI innovation, and enterprise deployment—driving high-impact AI outcomes for customers and codifying solution patterns for repeatable delivery at scale. We are looking for a seasoned, full-stack ML engineer who can embed with customers to design technical use cases and ship scalable enterprise AI/ML solutions on the Cloudera platform. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you will: Develop full-stack AI/ML applications on Cloudera to demonstrate how AI and agentic systems solve real enterprise use cases. Work directly with customer teams to drive AI and agentic use cases from early prototype toward production readiness. Advise customer leaders on AI roadmaps, solution design, deployment, and AI use cases. Standardize successful patterns into repeatable reference architectures, productized solutions, starter kits, and internal playbooks. Act as a thought leader, mentor Cloudera teams, and contribute to resources that grow our overall AI capability. Channel field and customer feedback back to Product teams to continuously improve our AI platform and products. We’re excited about you if you have: 7+ years of experience building and deploying production-grade systems. 2–4 years of experience specifically focused on building ML systems or GenAI and agentic applications. Strong hands-on software engineering, data engineering, and applied AI/ML skills. Demonstrated experience building full-stack ML applications or agentic systems using modern AI frameworks and tooling. You may also have: Experience with MLOps frameworks, LLM orchestration, and modern AI stacks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, vLLM, Ray, MLflow). Hands-on experience with Vector Databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures. Background in client-facing consulting, technical account management, or solution architecture within enterprise environments. Familiarity with distributed data engineering platforms ( Apache Spark, Iceberg, Kubernetes ). What you can expect from us: Generous PTO Policy Support work life balance with Unplugged Days Flexible WFH Policy Mental & Physical Wellness programs Phone and Internet Reimbursement program Access to Continued Career Development Comprehensive Benefits and Competitive Packages Paid Volunteer Time Employee Resource Groups EEO/VEVRAA #LI-AB1 #LI-Remote

nearMatches.text:
Recruitment Fraud Alert

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.  

What to know:

  • Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
  • We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com 

 

About Commvault 

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data. 

About the Team

The Clumio backend team designs, builds, and operates the cloud-native systems behind Clumio's data protection solutions — from the core SaaS platform to the systems that back up and recover large volumes of enterprise cloud data. In these environments backup is a compliance-, audit-, and security-driven requirement rather than a nice-to-have, so recovery performance, cost efficiency, and reliable operation at scale are our key differentiators.

Built on a fully cloud-native architecture, the platform scales dynamically with workload, delivers faster recovery and lower cost than native cloud backup, and stays correct under real-world failure conditions through reprocessing and retries. Beyond core backup and recovery, the team also builds customer onboarding, metering and billing, reporting, alerting, and ML-driven insights. We operate a mature, production-proven platform on AWS — including Amazon S3, DynamoDB, and the industry's first data protection solution for Apache Iceberg — and are actively expanding into multi-cloud data protection across GCP and Azure.

Role Overview

As a Software Engineer on the Clumio backend team, you implement and deliver features and components within the data protection platform, working under the guidance of Senior and Principal Engineers. This role focuses on writing reliable, maintainable, production-ready code as part of larger systems that are critical to customer-facing operations.

You take problems from implementation through to production — building features and workflows, writing tests, and helping operate and improve them once they ship. You make sound implementation decisions within an established design, learning to balance correctness, simplicity, and performance, and you grow your ownership of specific components over time.

This is a role built for growth. You'll learn how large-scale, cloud-native data protection systems are designed, operated, and kept correct under real-world failure — working on problems of genuine scale rather than toy projects. With close mentorship from Senior and Principal Engineers and regular code review, you'll sharpen your engineering fundamentals, take on steadily larger and more complex work, and grow along a clear path toward broader system ownership.

Basic Qualifications

  • Software engineering experience through professional roles internships, or academic and personal projects.
  • Solid grounding in computer science fundamentals — data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis — with the ability to apply them to practical problems.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Go, Java, Python, C++, Rust).
  • Ability to break a problem down into a correct, maintainable solution, and the instinct to ask clarifying questions when requirements are unclear.
  • A willingness to learn how production systems are built, operated, and debugged, with support from the team.
  • Working knowledge of English.

Note:Applicants must have valid authorization to work in South Korea. Commvault does not provide visa sponsorship for this role

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience contributing features to a larger backend or cloud-native platform.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and common cloud-native design patterns.
  • Familiarity with data-intensive systems, object storage, or large-scale backend services.
  • Exposure to backup, disaster recovery, or data protection systems.

You’ll Love Working Here Because ...

  • Collaborate with amazing, driven, and supportive team members.
  • Enjoy continuous professional growth through product training, development programs, and clear career pathways.
  • Work on high-impact, large-scale cloud data protection systems used by global enterprises.
  • Thrive in an inclusive, open culture with opportunities to connect through our community groups.
  • Take advantage of generous global benefits tailored to support your well-being.
  • Receive competitive compensation that reflects your impact.
  • Share in our success through our Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Note:Applicants must have valid authorization to work in South Korea. Commvault does not provide visa sponsorship for this role

#LI-Hybrid

 

Commvault is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are always committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status and we will not discriminate against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we work.

Commvault’s goal is to make interviewing inclusive and accessible to all candidates and employees. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to participate in the interview process or apply for a position at Commvault, please email accommodations@commvault.com For any inquiries not related to an accommodation please reach out to wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com.

For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data. 

About the Team

The Automation team at Clumio (Commvault) works closely with the backend team to help build and validate a cloud-scale SaaS backup platform that helps enterprises meet their cloud data protection needs. For many customers, backup is not a “nice-to-have” — it is a mandatory foundation driven by compliance, audit, and security requirements, where recovery speed, cost efficiency, and the ability to handle large-scale data are critical differentiators in real-world environments.

Our systems protect and recover large volumes of cloud object data in a cloud-native way. Compared to native cloud backup solutions, we deliver up to 10× faster recovery times, roughly half the cost for S3 workloads, and the ability to reliably support significantly larger data scales. These outcomes come from deliberate engineering decisions across system architecture, data flows, and failure-handling strategies.The platform is designed to gracefully handle and recover from failures through reprocessing and retries, while maintaining correctness and reliability at scale. The team operates a proven platform built on Amazon S3 and DynamoDB and is now expanding into multi-cloud data protection across GCP and Azure — an opportunity to apply and evolve our approach across diverse cloud ecosystems.

Beyond our SaaS solutions, we are also building AI agents that help our customers get more value from their data and operations. As a team, we embrace modern engineering practices, including agentic AI-assisted coding, to build and ship faster — and you will have the opportunity to work hands-on with these tools and techniques.

Role Overview

As a Software Engineer focused on automation, you will help ensure a very high engineering quality bar for Clumio’s best-in-class SaaS platform for data protection in the public cloud. You will work closely with Development, Product Management, and Customer Success teams, and grow your skills alongside experienced engineers. This is a great opportunity for a new college graduate or early-career engineer who is passionate about learning Python-based automation, and who wants to learn about modern SaaS platforms and their deployments in clouds like AWS, GCP, and Azure.

The team builds Python-based automation to interact with and manipulate AWS infrastructure that simulates customer environments, involving services such as EC2, RDS, DynamoDB, S3, Cognito, SQS, SNS, VPC, CloudFormation, Lambda, Kubernetes, and Docker. As an automation team member, you get to build best-in-class data-generation tools to set up scale environments and build REST API libraries.

What You’ll Do

  • Work with a highly motivated team of engineers in a fast-paced environment.
  • Design and build test automation frameworks and tools.
  • Set up infrastructure (storage, compute, networking) to run automated tests.
  • Design and implement automated tests, including end-to-end integration tests and load/stress tests.
  • Help drive adoption of best practices in testing and product quality.
  • Deliver under tight deadlines using agile methodology.
  • Participate in requirement reviews and collaborate with Customer Success teams to help resolve customer escalations.
  • Collaborate through design discussions and code reviews, and work with senior and principal engineers to align your work with the broader technical direction.

Qualifications

  • New college graduate, or 1+ year of industry experience in software development or test automation.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid programming fundamentals in an OOP language such as Python or Go.
  • A highly motivated self-starter with a builder’s mindset and a passion for quality.
  • Working knowledge of English.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to public cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Familiarity with Docker and container orchestration such as Kubernetes.
  • Internship, project, or coursework experience in test automation or backend systems.

You’ll Love Working Here Because…

  • You’ll collaborate with amazing, driven, and supportive teammates.
  • You’ll enjoy continuous professional growth through product training, development programs, and clear career pathways — ideal for early-career engineers.
  • You’ll work on high-impact, large-scale cloud data protection systems used by global enterprises.
  • You’ll thrive in an inclusive, open culture with opportunities to connect through our Community Guilds.
  • You’ll receive generous global benefits designed to support your well-being.
  • You’ll earn competitive compensation that reflects your impact.
  • You’ll share in our success through our Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

#LI-Hybrid

We are always committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status and we will not discriminate against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we work.

closest.title: Engineer III, Cloud SDET - Platform (Hybrid)
closest.text: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. About the Role: CrowdStrike is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) in the Platform product group responsible for authentication and authorization. The Auth team is responsible for both internal (e.g. Service-to-service authorization, etc.) and external (e.g. user login, etc) authN and authZ. The team is a critical part of cloud, frequently working collaboratively with many other product groups. The team builds and extends services that can make 1+ trillion decisions per day!. You'll be instrumental in building and scaling our next-generation test automation infrastructure, focusing on frameworks, libraries, and tooling that ensure the quality of our cloud services. We process millions of security events per second and manage petabytes of critical security data - the scale and impact of your work will be significant. We're seeking innovative problem-solvers who can take ownership of complex technical challenges and drive quality initiatives across our platform. You'll work with cutting-edge cloud technologies while helping protect organizations worldwide from sophisticated cyber threats. Success Means: Architecting and delivering scalable test automation solutions that can handle enterprise-scale workloads Breaking complex distributed systems in creative ways to uncover edge cases and potential vulnerabilities Taking ownership of quality initiatives that span across cloud services, data processing, and customer-facing applications Building robust frameworks that enable teams to deliver features with confidence Collaborating effectively across engineering teams to drive testing best practices Balancing speed and quality while working in a fast-paced security technology environment This role is hybrid, requiring 2-3 days per week on-site at one of the posted locations. What You'll Do: Design and implement scalable test automation frameworks for complex distributed systems involving cloud services and endpoint agent software. Develop comprehensive test strategies for security-critical features, focusing on reliability, accuracy, and performance at scale Review engineering technical designs with a focus on testability, security implications, and potential edge cases Create and maintain cloud-based test infrastructure that simulates real-world deployment scenarios Build tools and frameworks for testing complex agent-cloud interactions, data processing pipelines, and API integrations Drive root cause analysis for production issues and implement automated tests to prevent regression Mentor team members on test automation best practices and security-conscious testing approaches What You'll Need: 6+ years of combined experience as an SDET or Backend Developer 3+ years building testing frameworks and tooling for Cloud SaaS products Strong computer science fundamentals (algorithms, data structures, distributed systems) Expertise in at least one modern programming language: Go, Python, Java, C++, JavaScript/TypeScript Deep understanding of: Cloud architectures and microservices Web Services: REST, gRPC, Protocol Buffers or similar API technologies Data storage systems: PostgreSQL, Cassandra, Redis or similar databases Container technologies: Docker, Kubernetes or similar orchestration platforms Experience with CI/CD pipelines and testing in cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP) Strong debugging skills with ability to troubleshoot complex distributed systems Experience with cloud performance testing and monitoring tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling, New Relic, Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana) Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. Bonus Points: Previous experience testing security products, endpoint agents, or EDR solutions Understanding of endpoint security concepts and threat detection mechanisms Experience with real-time data processing systems (Kafka, Storm, Spark) Contributions to open source security tools or testing frameworks Knowledge of attack frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK) and common security vulnerabilities Experience with chaos engineering and resilience testing Background in any of: threat detection, incident response, or security operations Proven track record of building developer-friendly testing tools and frameworks #LI-MF1 #LI-SF1 This role will require the candidate to periodically undergo and pass additional background and fingerprint check(s) consistent with government customer requirements. Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike: Market leader in compensation and equity awards Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge Paid parental and adoption leaves Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections Vibrant office culture with world class amenities Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program. CrowdStrike is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, creed, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy or pregnancy-related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, membership or activity in a local human rights commission, status with regard to public assistance, or any other characteristic protected by law. We base all employment decisions--including recruitment, selection, training, compensation, benefits, discipline, promotions, transfers, lay-offs, return from lay-off, terminations and social/recreational programs--on valid job requirements. If you need assistance accessing or reviewing the information on this website or need help submitting an application for employment or requesting an accommodation, please contact us at recruiting@crowdstrike.com for further assistance. Find out more about your rights as an applicant. CrowdStrike participates in the E-Verify program. Notice of E-Verify Participation Right to Work CrowdStrike, Inc. is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Placement within the pay range is dependent on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications, job level, supervisory status, and location. The base salary range for this position for all U.S. candidates is $120,000 - $180,000 per year, with eligibility for bonuses, equity grants and a comprehensive benefits package that includes health insurance, 401k and paid time off. For detailed information about the U.S. benefits package, please click here .

closest.title: Sr. Developer - Zuora Billing & Revenue - 11080
closest.text: The Impact of a Sr Developer- Zuora at Coupa: We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Zuora Developer to serve as the technical architect and administrator for our Zuora Billing and Revenue ecosystem. This role is essential for driving the technical evolution, automation, and stability of our subscription management platform. This resource will bridge the gap between functional requirements and technical execution, leading the development of custom logic, managing API integrations, and ensuring the platform is optimized for scale. You will be a key player in our Quote-to-Cash transformation, working to build a robust, automated bridge between Salesforce and NetSuite What You’ll Do:: Technical Development and Automation Design, develop, and maintain custom solutions within the Zuora platform, utilizing Zuora Workflow , Custom Objects , and Custom Fields to automate complex billing scenarios. Develop and manage scripts or external applications that interact with the Zuora REST/SOAP APIs to extend platform functionality beyond out-of-the-box features. Build and optimize sophisticated SQL queries (Data Query) and reports to provide deep visibility into billing health and revenue metrics. Lead the technical side of "New Product Introduction" (NPI), ensuring the product catalog is architected for both billing flexibility and downstream reporting accuracy. System Administration and Architecture Serve as the primary technical administrator for Zuora Billing and Zuora Revenue, managing environment refreshes, tenant settings, and security configurations. Design the technical architecture for complex subscription models, including usage-based pricing, ramp deals, and multi-entity global deployments. Monitor system performance and API limits, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks or potential points of failure. Manage the deployment lifecycle for Zuora configurations, ensuring rigorous testing in Sandbox environments before production releases. Integration Engineering (Salesforce & NetSuite) Own the Technical Integration: Maintain and enhance the data flow between Salesforce (CPQ) and Zuora, ensuring high-fidelity synchronization of quotes, subscriptions, and amendments. Optimize Downstream Sync: Partner with the NetSuite team to manage the technical mapping of invoices, payments, and revenue schedules into the ERP via the Zuora NetSuite Connector or middleware. Troubleshoot complex integration errors (e.g., sync failures, callout timeouts) by analyzing logs and performing root-cause analysis across the tech stack. Strategic Partnership and Support Translate business requirements from Finance and Sales Ops into technical design documents and scalable code. Provide technical support for billing discrepancies and system bugs Collaborate with the broader IT and Engineering teams to ensure Zuora aligns with Coupa’s enterprise data architecture and security standards What you will bring to Coupa: : 5+ years of hands-on experience as a Zuora Administrator or Developer , with deep expertise in Zuora Billing. 2+ years of technical experience with Zuora Revenue (RevPro), including configuration of revenue rules and templates. Proficiency in Zuora APIs: Demonstrated experience building integrations or automations using REST/SOAP APIs and Zuora Object Query Language (ZOQL). Proficiency with Zuora Connectors to Salesforce , Netsuite . Development Skills: Strong SQL skills and experience with at least one programming/scripting language (e.g., Python, JavaScript, or Java) for automation. Advanced Configuration Knowledge: Expert-level understanding of Zuora Workflow, Data Query, and the Zuora-Salesforce 360 sync. Q2C Experience: Deep technical understanding of the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle, specifically how data moves from Salesforce CPQ into Zuora and NetSuite. Preferred Qualifications Zuora Certified Administrator or Zuora Certified Developer. Experience with Workato for orchestration. Familiarity with Apex (Salesforce) or SuiteScript (NetSuite) to better manage cross-platform logic. Experience with Tesorio as a Collections platform is a plus. Understanding of ASC 606 compliance from a technical implementation perspective. Core Competencies Analytical Rigor: A data-driven approach to troubleshooting and system design. Technical Communication: The ability to explain API logic or architectural constraints to non-technical stakeholders. Innovation Mindset: A drive to replace manual workarounds with scalable, automated code and workflows.

closest.title: AI Integration Engineer
closest.text:
Integration meets Innovation

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we’re on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.

We are seeking a Senior Integrations Engineer with expertise in Enterprise System Integrations and Business Process Automation. In this role, you will design, build, and deploy scalable integration solutions and automations, as well as develop AI chatbots using various technologies across multiple domains.

The Global Technology Operations team is dedicated to digitally transforming and scaling Celigo's business, enhancing productivity, and improving operational efficiency. We work closely with top talent across the company to drive both our business operations and product development. As an Integrations Engineer, you will support the business and finance teams by seamlessly connecting systems and data. Additionally, you will build automations using integrator.io and AI concepts to eliminate redundant tasks, enabling teams to focus on higher-value activities.

What would you do if hired?
  • Champion the Celigo product through transformational integrations that enable scalable business growth.
  • Design, build, and deliver scalable data pipelines leveraging modern cloud architectures.
  • Collaborate with business process experts to develop solutions for complex systems and data platforms that drive revenue growth.
  • Ensure your integrations adhere to engineering best practices, emphasizing data quality, accuracy, operability, and security.
  • Contribute to the development of AI chatbots for internal stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with technical and business teams.
  • Manage multiple projects concurrently, including operational tasks.
  • Serve as the owner and final escalation point for your integrations.
  • Produce clear, accurate technical documentation, develop support processes and procedures, and facilitate smooth hand-offs to peers and other organizational units.
Who are we looking for?

Experience & Technical Expertise:

    • Proven experience in developing AI agents or bots that autonomously interact with various tools and systems to derive and act upon business insights.
    • Expertise in integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) such as OpenAI's GPT series, Google's Gemini, or Anthropic's Claude with external APIs, vector databases, and enterprise platforms to automate workflows and enhance decision-making processes.
    • Strong understanding of prompt engineering, context management, and the orchestration of multi-step tasks using AI-driven solutions.
    • At least 5 years designing and building integration solutions, ideally within Sales or Customer Success domains.
    • Proficient with Enterprise iPaaS platforms (Celigo, Snaplogic, Boomi, Mulesoft, etc.).
    • Strong expertise in developing integrations using REST and SOAP APIs, with at least 2 years of experience in JSON and XML schema design.
    • Proficient in JavaScript for data processing within integration projects.
    • Familiar with various authentication mechanisms such as OAuth 2.0, SAML2, and JWT Bearer Tokens.
    • Hands-on experience with cloud applications like Salesforce, HubSpot, NetSuite, Zendesk, Gong, Gainsight, and similar platforms.
    • Working knowledge of SQL, Snowflake stored procedures, AWS S3, and Redshift, along with a clear understanding of integration design patterns.
    • Working knowledge on Agent SDKs, Model context protocol, Python is a plus.

  • Business Acumen & Communication:
    • Able to quickly learn business processes, understand requirements, and communicate designs that address both technical and business challenges.
    • Experience supporting business teams and a strong grasp of processes like Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Lead-to-Opportunity, and Hire-to-Retire.
    • Excellent written communication skills; experience with data visualization (graphs and plots) is a significant advantage.

  • Collaboration & Project Management:
    • Proven ability to interface with diverse stakeholders across various business units and levels, gathering requirements and managing follow-ups.
    • Demonstrated track record of delivering projects end-to-end with strong accountability.
    • Thinks like an owner—takes full charge of projects from inception to delivery while keeping Celigo’s best interests in mind.
    • Willingness to work flexible hours to effectively collaborate with US stakeholders.

  • Additional Qualifications:
    • A BS/BA in Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience is preferred.
    • Knowledge of system and software engineering architecture principles and best practices is a plus.

Celigo is proud to be

  • A 2025 Gartner Customers’ Choice for iPaaS. The ONLY vendor to receive this award.
  • Celigo is a Visionary in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for iPaaS for the second consecutive year
  • Celigo is ranked #1 iPaaS on G2 for multiple quarters and named a Leader in both B2B/EDI and API Management. 
  • Celigo is a leading intelligent automation platform that puts the power of automation in the hands of every team, unifying workflows from the predictable to the fully agentic in a single platform.

Here you’ll experience

  • A flexible, hybrid work culture that values autonomy, collaboration, and trust
  • A fast-paced, high-growth environment where innovation and ownership are encouraged at every level
  • Continuous learning and upskilling opportunities through internal training, mentorship, and global collaboration
  • Exceptional teammates who bring passion, purpose, and creativity to everything they do
  • A supportive, inclusive workplace that celebrates diverse ideas and perspectives
  • Comprehensive health insurance coverage for employees and dependents
  • Generous leave benefits, including paid time off, wellness days, and parental leave
  • Recognition programs and career growth opportunities designed to help you thrive
  • Modern office spaces that promote connection, collaboration, and fun.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility

As a company, one of the values we hold most dear is fostering a safe, collaborative environment to bring out the best in us, so we created our Taking a Stand Initiative. Our TAS initiative is a volunteer committee open to all Celigans, with representation from underrepresented voices within our company. We believe, unequivocally, that everyone deserves to be in a place where they feel welcome as they are. Learn more about Taking a Stand.

Celigo is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, disability, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

closest.title: Motion Designer II
closest.text:
What is Contentstack?

Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.

While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.

Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.

Learn more at www.contentstack.com.

Who Are We?

At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go!

Motion Designer 

Contentstack is seeking a motion designer to drive the creation of motion and animation assets across various marketing touchpoints for our US-based team. In this position, you’ll create engaging videos that tell our product, brand and customer stories while bringing our technology to life. This role is key in creating high-performing assets for events, OOH, digital advertising and 2D animated assets like explainers and other visual content related to our products and our technology. From designing storyboards to publishing, you will support our mission to explain how we enable companies to create exceptional digital experiences.

We expect this role to be responsive to feedback and able to deliver revisions in a timely manner. This role will interface largely with the Design Manager and Creative Producer. Content and Earned Media Leads, as well as internal stakeholders. Strong English reading comprehension is required for this role. 

Flexible Work Schedule: Working with a US-based team will require occasional evening meetings to bridge the 12-hour difference.

Experience : 2 - 5 Years 
Location : Bangalore 

Required skills

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite & Figma: (After Effects, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, Photoshop), Figma and other relevant motion design tools (Cinema 4D, etc.)
  • Experienced video editor: compositing, color grading, and audio editing and mixing.
  • Expert in animation principles: including timing, pacing, and storytelling
  • Knowledge of Lottie, Rive: ideally the candidate has knowledge of web animation file creation tools and outputs
  • Motion graphics & animation:
    • Create compelling 2D animations, motion graphics, and visual effects for a wide range of digital and offline media, including social media ads, web videos, presentations, trade show displays, TV commercials, and more
    • Develop dynamic UI animations at the direction of the design manager and brand look & feel
  • Video editing & post-production:
    • Edit raw footage, incorporating motion design, sound, and visual effects to deliver polished video assets for various platforms
    • Curation and selection of high-quality stock footage, shot footage, and music arrangements 
    • Integrate animations, graphics, and visual effects into video edits to create cohesive, high-impact content
  • Cross-platform adaptation:
    • Adapt and optimize designs for multiple formats, ensuring that assets are correctly formatted for social media, commercials, OOH signage and event-specific requirements.
    • Familiarity with web development or working with developers to implement motion design into live websites. HTML5 experience is a must.
  • AI-Assisted design & workflow Familiarity with AI tools as part of a modern motion design workflow including generative tools, AI-assisted video editing, and prompt-based asset creation. The ideal candidate uses AI to accelerate production without compromising brand quality or creative integrity.
  • Work independently: the ideal motion designer can work autonomously, have excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, and prep work for review at the end of their workday. 
  • Manage work tracking tools like Monday: no experience is needed in Monday, but the designer should be comfortable navigating a project tracking platform: receiving assignments, responding to messages, linking to files, understanding and honoring timelines, etc.

Bonus skills

  • Static, 2D design skills and storyboarding: graphic design experience is a bonus that includes creating 2D vector assets, sourcing imagery or footage, and concepting on transitions and best ways to architect a storyboard from a script. 

 

What Do We Offer?

Interesting Work | We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the “challenge yourself” role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you’re doing it. 

Tribe Vibe | We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict “no a**hole policy” and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.

Bragging Rights | We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!

One Team One Dream | This is one of our values, and it shows. We don’t believe in artificial hierarchies. If you’re part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it’s a great time to be joining…

The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.

Learn more at www.contentstack.com.

Who Are We?

At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go!


What Are We Looking For?

We are seeking a Senior BI Data Architect to lead the analytical modeling architecture and engineering standards that power reporting, semantic modeling, and AI-enabled analytics across the enterprise. In this high-impact role, you will establish scalable modeling patterns and reusable frameworks across Snowflake and dbt while partnering with leadership to operationalize governed metrics and long-term analytics strategy through architectural implementation best practices.


Key Responsibilities
Architectural Leadership and Governance
● Define and govern enterprise analytical architecture standards and scalable modeling frameworks across all layers (staging, intermediate, dimensional, fact, semantic, and mart layers), leveraging Snowflake and dbt.
● Establish standards for model grain declaration, naming conventions, ownership metadata, lineage, and documentation.
● Lead architectural design reviews for new modeling initiatives and analytical platform changes.
● Partner with Data Engineering teams to align ingestion patterns and source system architecture with downstream analytical requirements.

Data Modeling and Semantic Layer
● Lead the design and technical implementation of governed business entities, semantic models, and enterprise metrics in partnership with BI andAnalytics.
● Design, implement, and enforce secure access patterns (APIs, RBAC, query design) for
applications, AI agents, and self-service tools consuming Snowflake data through governed
semantic models.
● Translate complex business requirements from Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive leadership into scalable, trustworthy data models and BI solutions.


Analytics Engineering and Platform Enablement
● Establish and enforce scalable analytics engineering standards for dbt development, testing, deployment workflows, Git practices, CI/CD, model performance, observability, and deployment reliability.
● Partner with BI Data Engineering teams to improve model consistency, modularity, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
● Mentor analytics engineers on modular architecture, semantic implementation, reusable modeling patterns, and modern analytics engineering best practices.
● Evaluate and recommend tooling, governance capabilities, semantic technologies, and platform improvements that support scalability and reduce technical debt.


Required Qualifications:
● 8+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data architecture roles, with at least 3 years operating in a senior or lead architect capacity with direct analytical platform ownership.
● Deep, hands-on expertise with Snowflake architecture, including virtual warehouse design, RBAC, materialization strategies, dynamic tables, and query performance optimization.
● Expert-level dbt Labs practitioner with experience in staging/intermediate/mart conventions, Jinja macros, incremental strategies, testing frameworks, documentation, and reusable modeling patterns; dbt Certified Data Architect or Analytics Engineer certification preferred.

● Demonstrated experience designing and deploying production semantic layers serving governed metrics across BI platforms, analytics applications, and AI-enabled analytics workflows, including text-to-SQL and MCP-based analytics integrations.
● Strong command of dimensional and semantic modeling concepts, with the ability to select and justify the appropriate modeling approach based on business and analytical requirements.
● Advanced SQL proficiency and experience with Python; familiarity with modern analytics tooling including dbt Cloud, Fivetran, Git/CI-CD workflows, and cloud-native analytics environments.
● Experience designing secure access patterns for applications consuming Snowflake data, including APIs, service layers, RBAC, query performance, and governed semantic access.
● Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present architectural decisions to executive and cross-functional stakeholders.
● Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced certification strongly preferred.


Preferred Qualifications:
• Snowflake Cortex and Snowpark ML experience for in-warehouse AI/ML workloads.
• Experience with Salesforce as a source system, including GTM dimensional modeling from CRM objects.
• RAG architecture experience connecting LLMs to governed analytical data foundations.
• Experience working with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.
• Experience with data governance frameworks including data catalogs, column-level lineage, and row-level security.

Experience: 10-15 years
Location: Bangalore/Chennai

What Do We Offer?

Interesting Work | We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the “challenge yourself” role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you’re doing it. 

Tribe Vibe | We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict “no a**hole policy” and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.

Bragging Rights | We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!

One Team One Dream | This is one of our values, and it shows. We don’t believe in artificial hierarchies. If you’re part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it’s a great time to be joining…

The Role:

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will partner closely with our founders and the AI Product Managers to prototype and deploy AI‑driven solutions that solve our customers’ most pressing problems. This is a founding engineering role with high visibility; you will report directly to our Head of AI Strategy and Outcomes. You will also partner with other members of the executive leadership team who are based at our Mountain View HQ, collaborate with our Bangalore‑based engineering team, and engage daily with enterprise customers. You will help define how we work with our most important customers, shape the company’s first ever forward deployed engineering function, and contribute to our mission of helping brands win in AI‑driven e-commerce.

Location / Travel:

This position is on-site in Mountain View, CA with approximately 50% travel expected to client locations.

 

What You'll Do:

  • Build prototypes with customers: Work alongside our AI Product Manager to understand real‑world problems, rapidly scope use cases and create working prototypes. You’ll engage in hands-on discovery and convert insights into functional demos for prospective and existing customers.
  • Integrate data and create new AI agents: Ingest data from disparate sources (ERPs, ecommerce platforms, custom APIs) and build agents that solve the specific use cases uncovered during discovery. This includes turning edge‑case business rules into runtime‑editable settings rather than hard‑coded logic.
  • Own AI outcomes: Lead customer‑facing demonstrations and proof‑of‑concepts. You’ll instrument and tune models using production feedback loops to ensure prototypes deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Rapidly iterate & generalize: Collaborate with engineering teams in Bangalore to transform prototypes into robust features. Your work will be implemented into our core product - patterns that succeed in one deployment (custom adapters, monitoring dashboards) should be packaged as reusable modules.
  • Own the full lifecycle: Support engagements from pre‑sales scoping through post‑deployment refinement. You’ll help to negotiate scope, push back on unreasonable asks, and ensure long‑term customer success. Additionally, you’ll act as the technical liaison between customers, product managers, and engineering.
  • Cultivate customer relationships: Develop deep empathy for our customers’ business drivers and serve as their advocate. Use clear, engaging communication to convey technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders, build trust and handle high‑stakes conversations.

 

What You'll Bring: 

  • Experienced engineer (4-6 years or more) with a strong foundation in software development (coding, problem solving and debugging).
    • Comfortable coding in Python or Java and learning new technologies quickly.
  • Full‑stack & data integration skills. Experience connecting to APIs, working with SQL/NoSQL databases, streaming/ETL pipelines and deploying AI/LLM‑based agents.
  • Customer‑facing problem solver. You enjoy working directly with external users, conducting discovery, and translating ambiguous requirements into working solutions. You have excellent communication skills and the ability to simplify complex technical topics.
  • Rapid prototyper. You are biased towards action and are comfortable delivering minimal‑viable solutions, collecting feedback and iterating quickly.
  • Collaborative & global. You’re effective working across time zones with leadership in California and engineering in Bangalore. You embrace CommerceIQ’s leadership principles of ownership, deep diving into details, getting stuff done, thinking from first principles and winning as a team.
  • Independent & adaptable. You thrive in ambiguity, can manage your own backlog and priorities, and are motivated by the opportunity to create a new function.
  • Bachelor's degree, in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field

Nice to Haves:

  • Prior experience in a forward‑deployed, solutions engineering, technical product management or customer implementation role. Candidates coming from companies known for forward‑deployed engineering (e.g., Palantir, Scale AI, Ramp, Postman etc.) are strongly encouraged to apply.
  • Familiarity with e-commerce, retail, supply‑chain or ad‑tech data.
  • Exposure to large‑language‑model applications (fine‑tuning, prompt engineering, building retrieval‑augmented generation workflows).

 

Compensation and Benefits:

This base pay range may be inclusive of several career levels at CommerceIQ and will be narrowed based on a number of factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.

closest.title: Solutions Engineer - Managed Services
closest.text: Certa is the AI-first third-party operating system. Enterprises, from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups, use our no-code platform to onboard, assess, and monitor their vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. We have processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries, and are backed by Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures. As a Solutions Engineer - Managed Services, you'll ensure the successful integration and customization of our products for clients — configuring our software to meet each client's unique requirements and business use cases, and building the API integrations that enable seamless data flow between Certa and client systems. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Understand client needs: Collaborate with sales and client-facing teams to analyze client needs, business use cases, and requirements, and contribute to solution design discussions with insights grounded in the technology and business domain. - Configure the product: Configure and customize software solutions to client needs — setting up workflows, defining data structures, and enabling specific features and functionality. - Build & manage integrations: Partner with engineering to design, implement, and manage API integrations with external systems for smooth data exchange and interoperability. - Test, troubleshoot & document: Conduct unit testing, resolve configuration issues during implementation, and maintain detailed documentation of configurations, customizations, and integration processes. - Support clients: Guide clients through onboarding and post-implementation, and support product launches through technical support, training sessions, and resolving complex issues alongside customer support. - Collaborate & improve: Work cross-functionally with product, engineering, marketing, and sales, and stay current on product features and best practices to continuously improve the process. WHAT YOU'LL NEED - Experience: 3–5 years in a similar capacity with a proven track record of implementation excellence serving medium-to-large enterprise customers. - Education: Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Engineering or equivalent. - Technical skills: Proficiency in API integration (RESTful APIs and web services) and relevant programming languages/platforms, with experience in ERP integrations, JSON, SaaS products, and process/requirements tools like Miro or Visio a plus. - Analytical & process: Strong analytical skills to translate complex business use cases into technical solutions, and the ability to create structure and design effective processes in ambiguous situations. - Communication: Exceptional communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to interact with clients and explain technical concepts clearly. - Mindset: Results-oriented, curious, independent operator who can influence internal and external partners and act effectively with limited direction. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS - Compensation: Top of market salary + bonuses and equity - Time off: 49 days paid time off - Benefits: PTO, full benefits, retirement and wellness plans. - Growth: Professional development support, remote workspace setup bonus. - Team building: Annual company offsites in exciting locations around the world LOCATION - Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to: - London - San Francisco - Jaipur The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work and have face to face meetings. WHY CERTA - Category leadership. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools - recognition that we're defining the category, not following it. - Industry recognition. We've been honored across the analyst and awards landscape, including Top Tech and Customer Value distinctions in The Hackett Group's 2026 Risk Management SolutionMap, the ProcureTech100 (Advanced AI and Risk Management categories), and Best Overall eProcurement Software in the FinTech Breakthrough Awards. - A top place to work. Certa was named one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers in the US. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Understand client needs: Collaborate with sales and client-facing teams to analyze client needs, business use cases, and requirements, and contribute to solution design discussions with insights grounded in the technology and business domain. - Configure the product: Configure and customize software solutions to client needs — setting up workflows, defining data structures, and enabling specific features and functionality. - Build & manage integrations: Partner with engineering to design, implement, and manage API integrations with external systems for smooth data exchange and interoperability. - Test, troubleshoot & document: Conduct unit testing, resolve configuration issues during implementation, and maintain detailed documentation of configurations, customizations, and integration processes. - Support clients: Guide clients through onboarding and post-implementation, and support product launches through technical support, training sessions, and resolving complex issues alongside customer support. - Collaborate & improve: Work cross-functionally with product, engineering, marketing, and sales, and stay current on product features and best practices to continuously improve the process. WHAT YOU'LL NEED - Experience: 3–5 years in a similar capacity with a proven track record of implementation excellence serving medium-to-large enterprise customers. - Education: Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Engineering or equivalent. - Technical skills: Proficiency in API integration (RESTful APIs and web services) and relevant programming languages/platforms, with experience in ERP integrations, JSON, SaaS products, and process/requirements tools like Miro or Visio a plus. - Analytical & process: Strong analytical skills to translate complex business use cases into technical solutions, and the ability to create structure and design effective processes in ambiguous situations. - Communication: Exceptional communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to interact with clients and explain technical concepts clearly. - Mindset: Results-oriented, curious, independent operator who can influence internal and external partners and act effectively with limited direction. Encourage experimentation and ideation to find creative solutions that address both internal and client needs. Strong understanding of AI technologies and their application in both product development and custom client solutions. Exceptional leadership and communication skills, capable of influencing stakeholders and driving collaboration across teams. Expertise in managing Agile, Scrum, or other project management methodologies. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable business strategies. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, or related field; advanced degree or MBA preferred. Experience: 15-18 years of experience in both product development and solutions delivery, with at least 2-3 years of focus on AI technologies. Proven track record of delivering AI-driven products and custom solutions in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Experience in leading diverse teams across product and solution development lifecycles.
