closest.text: Your role What you'll be doing Software Engineer What We Need Corpay is currently looking to hire a Software Engineer to join our Alpha team within the Corporate Payments line of business. This position is based in Malta. As a Software Engineer at Alpha, you will contribute to the design and development of our eMoney and FX payment systems. You will work closely with senior engineers to implement scalable and secure solutions while honing your technical skills. Your role will involve collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver software that adheres to industry standards, technical guidelines, and regulatory requirements. How We Work As a Software Engineer at Alpha, Corpay will set you up for success by providing: Assigned workspace in our Malta office Company-issued equipment Formal, hands-on training Role Responsibilities The responsibilities of the role will include: Providing significant contribution to the design, development, and maintenance of secure and scalable payment systems. Collaborating with senior engineers and project teams to follow technical standards and ensure adherence to best practices during the software development lifecycle. Meaningful participation in code reviews, offering and receiving constructive feedback to enhance code quality and ensure secure coding practices are maintained. Implementing features based on requirements gathered from cross-functional teams, aligning them with business needs and technical objectives. Assisting in the documentation of software development processes, ensuring compliance with internal policies and industry standards. Utilising data handling and processing techniques to support efficient and optimised system performance. Supporting the monitoring of system performance, identifying areas for improvement and optimisation under the guidance of more senior engineers. Contributing to architectural discussions, providing feedback and suggestions to improve system design and technical direction. Communicating progress and technical challenges effectively to stakeholders, both technical and non-technical. Qualifications & Skills Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Minimum of 2 years of experience in software engineering, preferably with at least 1 year in a Software Engineer role within fintech, asset management, FX, payment processing, or eMoney sectors. Proficiency in C#/.NET. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP and microservices architecture, with experience in developing scalable applications. Ability to work semi-independently on features while receiving mentorship and guidance from more senior engineers. Basic understanding of secure development practices and familiarity with threat modelling and risk assessment techniques. Good time management and organisational skills, with the ability to work on multiple tasks simultaneously. Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical colleagues. A collaborative mindset, with a proven ability to work well within teams and build strong working relationships across departments. Benefits & Perks Private Health Insurance and Life Insurance for all employees from Day 1 of employment, including private hospital coverage. Pension scheme. Employee Assistance Programme (EAP). Annual fitness allowance. Sponsored learning and development. Quarterly Events & Celebrations. Brand-new state-of-the-art office. About Corpay About Corpay Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments. At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally. As part of our hiring process, offers of employment may be subject to the successful completion of pre-employment screening conducted by an authorized third-party provider, in accordance with applicable laws and Corpay policies. Screening requirements may include employment references, identity verification, criminal record checks, financial or sanctions screening, and other background checks relevant to the role and permitted by local law. Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms: Corpay does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms without a valid written agreement in place. Any unsolicited candidate submissions will become the property of Corpay, and no fees will be paid related to such submissions. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Corpay is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where individuals are respected and valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. These tools are designed to enhance efficiency, consistency, and fairness throughout the hiring process. AI tools do not make final hiring decisions. All employment decisions involve human review. Corpay is committed to the responsible use of AI, including appropriate oversight and safeguards designed to support fair and unbiased outcomes. Pay Philosophy Corpay is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices. closestEng.text: Your role What you'll be doing Software Engineer What We Need Corpay is currently looking to hire a Software Engineer to join our Alpha team within the Corporate Payments line of business. This position is based in Malta. As a Software Engineer at Alpha, you will contribute to the design and development of our eMoney and FX payment systems. You will work closely with senior engineers to implement scalable and secure solutions while honing your technical skills. Your role will involve collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver software that adheres to industry standards, technical guidelines, and regulatory requirements. How We Work As a Software Engineer at Alpha, Corpay will set you up for success by providing: Assigned workspace in our Malta office Company-issued equipment Formal, hands-on training Role Responsibilities The responsibilities of the role will include: Providing significant contribution to the design, development, and maintenance of secure and scalable payment systems. Collaborating with senior engineers and project teams to follow technical standards and ensure adherence to best practices during the software development lifecycle. Meaningful participation in code reviews, offering and receiving constructive feedback to enhance code quality and ensure secure coding practices are maintained. Implementing features based on requirements gathered from cross-functional teams, aligning them with business needs and technical objectives. Assisting in the documentation of software development processes, ensuring compliance with internal policies and industry standards. Utilising data handling and processing techniques to support efficient and optimised system performance. Supporting the monitoring of system performance, identifying areas for improvement and optimisation under the guidance of more senior engineers. Contributing to architectural discussions, providing feedback and suggestions to improve system design and technical direction. Communicating progress and technical challenges effectively to stakeholders, both technical and non-technical. Qualifications & Skills Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Minimum of 2 years of experience in software engineering, preferably with at least 1 year in a Software Engineer role within fintech, asset management, FX, payment processing, or eMoney sectors. Proficiency in C#/.NET. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP and microservices architecture, with experience in developing scalable applications. Ability to work semi-independently on features while receiving mentorship and guidance from more senior engineers. Basic understanding of secure development practices and familiarity with threat modelling and risk assessment techniques. Good time management and organisational skills, with the ability to work on multiple tasks simultaneously. Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical colleagues. A collaborative mindset, with a proven ability to work well within teams and build strong working relationships across departments. Benefits & Perks Private Health Insurance and Life Insurance for all employees from Day 1 of employment, including private hospital coverage. Pension scheme. Employee Assistance Programme (EAP). Annual fitness allowance. Sponsored learning and development. Quarterly Events & Celebrations. Brand-new state-of-the-art office. closest.text: Career Area: Manufacturing Job Description: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Job Summary Coordinate new product introductions and the implementation of engineering changes by applying APQP and PPAP methodologies, ensuring production process readiness, product quality, and compliance with customer requirements. Responsibilities: Participating in identifying and implementing enhancements and modifications to equipment and processes. Lead implementation of Engineering Changes and CPI. Monitoring equipment and process reliability; identifying and addressing problem areas. Analyzing engineering change notices, determines any part or process change, initiates and implements all changes. Providing engineering support on planning, development, operation, and maintenance of equipment, processes, or facilities. Education requirements : Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field. Intermediate English-speaking level. Candidates must have skills Collaborative Automation Lead and support the implementation of Engineering Changes (ECNs) and Continuous Product Improvement (CPI) initiatives across manufacturing operations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify, develop, and implement equipment and process enhancements that improve operational performance. Provide engineering support to operations, maintenance, quality, and production teams to ensure successful execution of manufacturing initiatives. Decision Making and Critical Thinking Analyze engineering change notices to determine required part, tooling, equipment, or process modifications and effectively implement changes. Evaluate equipment and process performance data to identify improvement opportunities and support informed decision-making. Assess manufacturing challenges and recommend solutions that improve reliability, quality, and productivity. Manufacturing Processes Minimum of 2 years of experience in manufacturing, project engineering, or cylinder product operations. Provide technical engineering support for the planning, development, operation, and maintenance of manufacturing equipment, processes, and facilities. Support implementation and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes to ensure safety, quality, delivery, and cost objectives are achieved. Lean Manufacturing Participate in and support continuous improvement activities focused on reducing waste and increasing operational efficiency. Lead and execute CPI initiatives that improve manufacturing performance and process standardization. Identify opportunities to optimize equipment utilization, process flow, and production effectiveness through Lean principles. Problem Solving Monitor equipment and process reliability, identify problem areas, and implement corrective actions to improve performance. Investigate manufacturing and process issues, determine root causes, and drive sustainable solutions. Support troubleshooting activities and provide technical recommendations to minimize downtime and improve operational reliability. Additional information: Location: Santa Catarina, Nuevo Leon (On-Site 100%) Schedule: Monday to Friday 6:24am - 5pm, (subject to changes; availability for shift changes, weekend coverage: one weekend per month based on staff rotation). <10% of working time will be domestic & international travel. Domestic relocation assistance is available for this position. Final details: The Caterpillar Code of Conduct states that we will select, and place employees based on their qualifications for the job to be performed, without regard to race, religion, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age or disability. In this company we do not request pregnancy tests, nor HIV tests as requirements for employment entry, permanence or promotion. Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status. Posting Dates: agosto 7, 2026 - agosto 14, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community .

nearMatches.title: Software Test Engineer
nearMatches.text: About Us Innovation. Sustainability. Productivity. This is how we are Breaking New Ground in our mission to sustainably advance the noble work of farmers and builders everywhere. With a growing global population and increased demands on resources, our products are instrumental to feeding and sheltering the world. From developing products that run on alternative power to productivity-enhancing precision tech, we are delivering solutions that benefit people – and they are possible thanks to people like you. If the opportunity to build your skills as part of a collaborative, global team excites you, you’re in the right place. Grow a Career. Build a Future! Be part of this company at the forefront of agriculture and construction, that passionately innovates to drive customer efficiency and success. And we know innovation can’t happen without collaboration. So, everything we do at CNH Industrial is about reaching new heights as one team, always delivering for the good of our customers. #LI-DNI Duties : The Software Test Engineer at CNH Industrial America LLC in Oak Brook, IL will utilize Hardware-In-the-Loop (HIL) testing equipment along with automation tools to effectively perform test execution, root-cause analysis, and reporting. Maintain, design, and operate the HIL simulators and the automated tests for embedded software. Design, develop, and maintain the automated HIL test systems. Develop simulations and models to support HIL configuration and testing. Assist in electrical and mechanical modifications to test systems. Design, plan, and collaborate with vendors on major upgrades or development of new test systems. Execute testing on multiple hardware variants per software release. Develop robust, flexible, and reusable test scripting for automated testing. Evaluate functional and performance requirements for defining test plans and procedures. Analyze test failures to identify root causes, such as incorrect test cases and software defects. Manage the debugging of electrical, simulation, and automated test script components of test systems to support root cause analysis. Create test reports, defects and communicate test results to team members. Collaborate with the software, system, and hardware engineering teams to gather input for testing the devices under test. Analyze requirements and test requests to define the testing approach, changes, and test plan. Oversee supplier test development and other support activities. Identify and implement new procedures for process improvements. Provide informal guidance to test engineers through an agile work environment in both product owner and release engineer roles. Telecommuting permitted 3 days per week. Salary: $88,088 - $132,825/year Minimum Requirements: Requires a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electronic Engineering or related field plus 3 years of experience as a quality engineer or related occupation for heavy equipment in agriculture. The 3 years of experience must include 3 years of experience with each of the following: (1) dSPACE, including Automation Desk, Configuration Desk, and Control Desk; (2) SIMULINK to create models for integration into a real-time interface; (3) VECTOR tools, including CANALYZER and CANoe; (4) test design, including testing techniques and methodologies; and (5) COGNEX for measuring key performance indicators; and (6) Azure or Java Agile development. CNH Industrial America LLC's ongoing employee referral program does apply to this position. Interested candidates see all job duties and requirements, and apply online at http://cnh.com/ See Job ID 4931. Click here to learn more about our benefits offerings! CNH Industrial participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. You can view additional information here . closest.text: No Relocation Assistance Offered Job Number #173257 - Piscataway, New Jersey, United States Who We Are Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name! Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all. Global Information Technology’s Global Application and America’s Marketing group invite applicants for a web analytics & personalization developer. This role is integral to supporting our first-party data strategy within the marketing department through the generation, storage, reporting, and analysis of web traffic and user experiences to derive actionable insights. This position is based out of the Piscataway, NJ location. Work visa sponsorship is not available for this position. What you'll do Analytics Implementation & Governance: Lead the end-to-end tagging process using Google Tag Manager, ensuring strict adherence to data layer standards and implementation best practices. Tag Development & Maintenance: Act as the internal expert for GA4 and GTM, writing custom JavaScript when necessary to implement, debug, and troubleshoot complex site tags. Quality Assurance & Compliance: Conduct regular tagging audits and data integrity checks to ensure accurate tracking and full alignment with user consent and privacy regulations. Reporting & KPI Management: Design and maintain automated dashboards to track core website KPIs, providing critical performance data to Marketing, Creative, and Planning teams. Testing & Personalization: Implement and support A/B testing and custom user experiences using Adobe Target, while reporting on the effectiveness of site optimizations. Strategic Stakeholder Liaison: Collaborate with web optimization and development teams to translate business requirements into technical tracking strategies and actionable insights. Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field or equivalent relevant experience Expert knowledge of Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager 3+ years of web analytics experience with digital marketing and application (customer-facing portals) environment required 3+ years of experience with web analytics process design, implementation and documentation management experience Preferred Qualifications: 3+ years of experience in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and jQuery, with specific expertise in Single Page Applications (SPA) and Google Apps Script. 1-2 years of hands-on experience with Adobe Target, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), and data manipulation using SAS/SQL. Proven track record of implementing and managing complex tagging strategies across large, enterprise-level web properties. Demonstrated ability to discover and analyze complex data sets and translate those findings into clear, actionable business insights. Compensation and Benefits Salary Range $94,000.00 - $137,000.00 USD Pay is determined based on experience, qualifications, and location. Salaried employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, profit-sharing, and long-term incentives for Executive-level roles. Benefits: Salaried employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid parental leave, disability coverage, and participation in the 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions subject to eligibility requirements. Additional benefits include a minimum of 15 vacation/PTO days (hourly employees receive a minimum of 120 hours) and 13 paid holidays (vacation days are prorated based on the employee's hire date within the calendar year). Paid sick leave is adjusted based on role and location in accordance with local laws. Detailed information regarding paid sick leave entitlements will be provided to employees upon hiring and may be subject to adjustments based on changes in legislation or company policies. Our Commitment to Inclusion Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business. Equal Opportunity Employer Colgate is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, marital status, veteran status (United States positions), or any other characteristic protected by law. Reasonable accommodation during the application process is available for persons with disabilities. Please complete this request form should you require accommodation. For additional Colgate terms and conditions, please click here . #LI-Hybrid

Strategic Stakeholder Liaison: Collaborate with web optimization and development teams to translate business requirements into technical tracking strategies and actionable insights. Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field or equivalent relevant experience Expert knowledge of Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager 3+ years of web analytics experience with digital marketing and application (customer-facing portals) environment required 3+ years of experience with web analytics process design, implementation and documentation management experience Preferred Qualifications: 3+ years of experience in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and jQuery, with specific expertise in Single Page Applications (SPA) and Google Apps Script. 1-2 years of hands-on experience with Adobe Target, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), and data manipulation using SAS/SQL. Proven track record of implementing and managing complex tagging strategies across large, enterprise-level web properties. Demonstrated ability to discover and analyze complex data sets and translate those findings into clear, actionable business insights. closest.title: Technical Product Specialist
closest.text: PRODUCT SPECIALIST AT CLARISIGHTS: TACTICAL WIZARD AT THE HEART OF OUR BUSINESS Are you a data-driven insight generator ready to dive deep into marketing analytics and support multi-million dollar portfolios? Clarisights seeks exceptional Product Specialists who can transform complex data into actionable insights for some of the world's most innovative, influential companies: Uber, Delivery Hero, HelloFresh, Universal Music Group, and many more. Role Overview As an Product Specialist at Clarisights, you're the tactical wizard at the heart of our business. You'll support Customer Success Managers, working hands-on with our powerful platform to deliver exceptional value to our customers. Your role is crucial in translating customer needs into technical specifications and turning data into insights that drive business decisions. What sets this role apart is your ability to work with a diverse tech stack, your hands-on experience in building reports and dashboards, and your knack for using data analysis tools. You'll be the go-to person for tactical execution, supporting high-agency relationships with both external and internal stakeholders, and continually finding ways to improve our customers' decision-making through data-driven insights. Key Responsibilities - Assist in pilot projects, helping to define success criteria and clearly define customer / business requirements translate customer needs into product features - Build and optimize dashboards that showcase Clarisights' value proposition - Contribute to growth strategies with data-driven insights - Help manage and grow relationships with large international customers - Identify and execute on expansion opportunities within customer organizations - Continuously optimize customer processes and drive product adoption - Work hands-on with the Clarisights platform and various data analysis tools - Build and maintain reports and dashboards using customer and Clarisights tech stacks - Translate customer requests into technical specifications for the engineering team - Assist in feature prioritization and delivery - Provide tactical support for go-to-market strategies and product marketing initiatives - Serve as a key liaison between customers, PMs, and the engineering team Ideal Candidate We're looking for individuals who excel in three core areas: 1. Data Analysis and Insight Generation: You have a knack for turning raw data into meaningful insights. You're comfortable working with large datasets and have experience using tools like Python or R for data analysis. 2. Technical Proficiency: You have hands-on experience with BI tools, data storage solutions, and analytics platforms. You're adept at building reports and dashboards and can quickly learn new tools and technologies. 3. Customer Understanding: You have the ability to understand customer needs and translate them into technical requirements. You're curious about how businesses operate and how data can drive their success. Experience - 3 - 5 years What Makes an Exceptional Product Specialist at Clarisights? - Problem-solving skills with a tactical, execution-focused mindset - Technical curiosity and the ability to quickly learn new tools and systems - Deep appreciation for data: its sources, storage, usage, and business-transforming potential - Excellent communication skills, able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Technical Landscape At Clarisights, Product specialists work extensively with a diverse technical ecosystem. Familiarity with these tech stacks is crucial for success in this role: Customer Stack: - BI Tools: Looker, Clicksense, Tableau - Hybrid Solutions: Datorama, Mode Analytics, Metabase, Domo - Storage & Compute: GCP, Bigquery, Snowflake, Redshift, Azure Cloud - Essentials: Excel, Google Sheets, SQL Clarisights Stack: - Metabase (Metadata layer) - Kibana (ELK Stack) - Graphana (Metrics) Competitor Stack: - Funnel, Supermetrics, Datorama, Adverity, Fivetran Hands-on experience with Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, and at least one BI tool is expected. Knowledge of Python or R for data analysis is a significant plus. Your ability to work with these tools and quickly learn new ones will be key to your success as an PS at Clarisights. The Problem Lifecycle As an PS you'll be deeply involved in various stages of the problem lifecycle, including: 1. Analyzing customer data and reporting challenges 2. Building and optimizing dashboards and reports 3. Assisting in data integration and quality assurance 4. Supporting pilot execution and feedback collection 5. Helping transition pilots to full implementation 6. Continuously improving product usage through data-driven insights 7. Supporting upsell opportunities with detailed analytics Your Journey at Clarisights When you join Clarisights as an Product Specialist , your path to success is clearly defined: 1. Months 0-3: Immerse yourself in our product, customers, and processes. You'll learn to execute assignments with support from Customer Success Managers and other team members. 2. Months 3-6: Begin to independently manage tasks and internal stakeholders. You'll take ownership of small projects and portions of larger projects. 3. Month 6 onwards: Start to independently handle customers with support from CSMs. You'll gradually take on more strategic responsibilities. This structured progression ensures you're well-equipped to grow from a tactical wizard into a strategic thinker, setting you up for success. Application Process Our hiring process takes 2-3 weeks and includes: 1. Culture and Fit Interview: Over a 30-minute call we will outline the opportunity, review your work experience, and look for signs and evidence of culture fit. 2. Round 1 Interview: You will a member of the Customer Success Team. Technical interview focused on data analysis skills 3. Assignment: Over a short call you will be given an assignment that will involve working with data and making a presentation. You will connect with a peer to understand the expectations from the assignment. We expect applicants to revert with their submissions in a week. 4. Assignment presentation: 60-90 min presentation and discussion about the assignment 5. Meet the founders: Meet at least one of Clarisight's founders. 6. Offer and Closing: Finally you will meet a member of the talent team to close on your compensation details and date of joining. Welcome to Clarisights! We welcome applicants with 2-8 years of relevant experience. If you're excited about turning data into business insights and ready to be at the heart of a fast-growing SaaS business, we want to hear from you! Clarisights is an equal-opportunity employer that welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

closest.title: What Insurance Risk Regulatory Frameworks now require
closest.text: Insurance risk regulation has quietly changed shape. The frameworks that rating agencies and regulators apply to insurers no longer accept a simplified estimate of what a portfolio would be worth under stress. Increasingly, they expect insurers to demonstrate a genuinely recalculated value — every instrument, repriced under each prescribed condition.
